firstPlayerRule: The person who most recently played tag starts the first round.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose a starting player randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: The round has four phases: Hide, Catch, Shine, and Sneak. The starting player takes the first turn during Catch.
